title: Wendell and the Ember
author: Hazel Crane
blurb: Ivo Delacroix, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
